title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
description: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with both David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware of their conduct".

title: Why Walliams' unprecedented legal battle to stay anonymous failed
description: The 55-year-old was named in reports by ITV News and the Guardian on Tuesday after losing a court bid to stop allegations being made public.

title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive
description: Thousands of messages seen by BBC show how a Chinese official sought details of sensitive political matters.

title: Temperatures to dip to -5C as first cold health alerts of season issued
description: The most widespread frost of the season so far is forecast for many parts of the country. BBC Weather's Tomasz Schafernaker reports.

title: 'If I tell you to run, run': BBC joins a Ukrainian drone unit as it protects a front-line city
description: Slovyansk continues to be bombarded by Russian forces, making it almost uninhabitable with less than 10% of its pre-war population remaining.

title: Prince George's artwork featured in Country Life magazine
description: The Prince of Wales features his 13-year-old son's drawing of a bird as part of a special edition of the magazine.

title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
description: The 41-year-old senior soldier is accused of national security offences and is being questioned in London.

title: Sales of traditional toys rise as public debate around screen time grows
description: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.
